create_LennardJonesEnergy: create a LennardJonesEnergy instance with a cutoff, epsilon, sigma, and optional soft-core lambda_lj parameter
compute_energy_LennardJonesEnergy: compute the pairwise potential energy for particle coordinates using a LennardJonesEnergy instance with periodic boundary conditions
compute_forces_LennardJonesEnergy: compute forces on each particle from a LennardJonesEnergy instance given particle coordinates and box length
compute_pairwise_forces_LennardJonesEner: compute pairwise forces between all particle pairs using LennardJonesEnergy pairwise_forces method with PBC
configure_soft_core_LennardJonesEnergy: configure a soft-core Lennard-Jones potential by setting lambda_lj between 0 and 1 to interpolate between uniform and standard LJ
